name: Duolingo Max
tagline: AI-powered language learning with personalised tutoring
description: Duolingo Max is the GPT-4-powered tier of Duolingo. It introduces Roleplay (open-ended chat with AI characters), Explain My Answer (personalised feedback on mistakes), and Video Call (real-time conversation with an AI character). Designed to bridge structured drills and real-world conversation practice.
pricingDetails: Duolingo Max: $29.99/month or $167.99/year (rolls up Super features plus AI). Family plan available.
